resources.string: LipaBill uses Android’s AccessibilityService API to help complete M-Pesa USSD payments you start and confirm in the app (Send money, Pay bill/till/Pochi, and Repeat). After you confirm and enter your PIN on LipaBill’s secure keypad, the service may read on-screen USSD prompts and fill the next step for that payment session only. That on-screen text is not stored as a transcript, not sent off this phone, and not shared. It does not read SMS, does not change system settings, and is not used to control unrelated apps when you are not paying. Your M-Pesa PIN is never stored. You can turn this service off anytime in Android Accessibility settings.
